attributes.action: Proper street lighting in predominantly elderly communities.
attributes.additional_details: My petition is to ensure that our elderly communities can leave their homes safely at any hour without worrying about whether they can see the edge of the curb. Even though it gets dark later in the summer, it’s still an issue as these communities remain sociable, and that shouldn’t have to stop because of safety concerns. Furthermore, in the winter months, it gets dark around 4 p.m., which is far too early for people to feel unsafe going out due to poor lighting.
attributes.background: I want the government to install efficient lighting in areas where they know elderly people predominantly live, to create a safer and more easily walkable environment for those with mobility issues or impaired vision.

rejection.details:
Decisions about street lighting are a matter for local authorities, not the UK Government or Parliament.

You could raise this issue with a local councillor who represents you. You can use this page to find out who your local councillors are, and how to contact them: https://www.gov.uk/find-your-local-councillors
